objective: train a raw two-channel HPA localization model and evaluate it once on an independent-provider OpenCell localization holdout at the target-protein unit

HPA_raw_development_expansion.reason: the finite-input HPA-only v1 CNN reached 0.4278 sealed-test macro average precision against the unchanged 0.50 screen; expand source data instead of lowering the endpoint or opening OpenCell
HPA_raw_development_expansion.selection: retain every existing 512-subset row in its original split, add at most one image per previously unused gene-antibody component by frozen coarse-class round-robin and salted SHA-256 order, and add no sealed-test row

leakage_contract.development_split: use the pre-existing HPA connected-component train, validation, calibration, and test labels without moving any row
leakage_contract.external_protein_exclusion: exclude every OpenCell target whose exact case-sensitive gene symbol occurs anywhere in the 512-image HPA raw subset
leakage_contract.external_unit: tagged target protein, not field of view
leakage_contract.fov_aggregation: arithmetic mean of pre-sigmoid logits across selected projections for each target protein

label_contract.HPA_labels: map every released author location through the same ordered substring mapping
label_contract.primary_external_target: at least one grade-2-or-3 label and every such label maps to the frozen ontology
label_contract.semantic_OOD_target: at least one grade-2-or-3 label and none of those labels maps to the frozen ontology
label_contract.annotation_column_resolution: casefold and remove non-alphanumeric characters; required semantic fields are gene symbol, localization category, and integer grade; ambiguous or missing resolution refuses the source

external_sampling_contract.in_domain_rule: iterate canonical classes in protocol order and add hash-sorted eligible unseen proteins until each class has contributed at most 48 newly selected targets; a multi-label target is added only once
external_sampling_contract.semantic_OOD_rule: select the first 128 unseen semantic-OOD targets by salted SHA-256 order
external_sampling_contract.projection_rule: for each selected target use at most two projection TIFF objects, selected by salted SHA-256 of the full S3 key
external_sampling_contract.missing_projection: exclude target and report; refuse if fewer than 100 in-domain targets remain

image_contract.OpenCell_channel_resolution: use TIFF/OME channel names or wavelengths; if absent, accept only an exact two-channel projection whose released order is 405 then 488; otherwise refuse
image_contract.per_channel_scaling: clip to finite p1 and p99 within each field, scale to [0,1], and emit all zeros if p99 is not above p1
image_contract.geometry: center-crop to square then area-resize to 128x128

model_contract.loss: BCEWithLogitsLoss with train-only per-class positive weights clipped to [1,20]
model_contract.early_stopping: maximum HPA-validation macro average precision, patience 15, ties choose earlier epoch
model_contract.augmentation: train only; seeded random dihedral transform from rotations 0/90/180/270 and optional horizontal reflection
model_contract.device: CPU unless a separately recorded Slurm GPU grant exists
model_contract.thresholds: per-class F1-maximizing thresholds on HPA validation over grid 0.05..0.95 step 0.025, ties closest to 0.5 then higher threshold
model_contract.temperature: one positive scalar fitted on HPA calibration logits only by multilabel negative log likelihood

uncertainty_contract.method: HPA-calibration class-conditional positive-label split conformal sets after frozen scalar temperature
uncertainty_contract.prediction_set: include class c when 1-p_c is at most its HPA-calibration positive-label higher quantile
uncertainty_contract.external_primary_coverage: fraction of true positive target-label entries included
uncertainty_contract.insufficient_HPA_calibration_class: set diagnostic nonconformity threshold to 1.0, mark the class uncertainty-ineligible, and fail the overall external uncertainty gate if OpenCell support reaches the reporting minimum

semantic_OOD_contract.score: one minus maximum calibrated in-ontology class probability

failure_policy.endpoint_failure: retain as training-only cross-provider diagnostic and permanently consume the selected OpenCell targets
failure_policy.success: promote only the coarse raw-IF localization head to externally validated uncertainty-aware observable inference

pre_external_access_addendum.reason: the first HPA-only training execution stopped before artifact creation because the calibration split had two nuclear-envelope and two ER positives; this rule resolves sparse internal calibration without opening or using OpenCell
